what: The Post preview sheet: the listing as each site will show it, and one Approve that says exactly what it will post, with Undo after (spec/pages.md §6.8).
frame: Who: Sam posting a draft for the first time (the first public act in their name); Dana posting forty drafts from a folder.
Came to do: check that each site shows the right thing, then post with one tap.
Costliest mistake: posting the wrong price or a fact nobody checked, in public, on several sites at once.
Ways out (ways-out.md §6.8): untick a site; different words per site (each written for its buyers, edge-cases §5); post later; Retry, Skip or Post it myself for a site that failed.
The person stays in the loop at: Approve, which is the only way anything posts, names the price and the number of sites, and becomes Undo once posted.
decisions: Each site's preview is written for its buyers: brand first, 'size L' where the site labels size, model and specs where the title is short, cut to the length its buyers read; one line says who buys there (edge-cases §5 (agent proposal); lengths and order from platform-fit.json).

Approve names the price and the count of sites ('Post at $235 on 2 sites'), steps through 'Posting 1 of 2', then becomes Undo (pages.md §6.8 and the hand-off rule: posting is the first public act in the person's name).

A failed site says the site's reason and offers Retry, Skip this site and Post it myself, which opens the site (ways-out §6.8 'The post keeps failing'; copying the words needs a clipboard module the app does not have yet).
Each card is one height (72 row, then 20, 20, 24 lines), its lines inset to the card's corner (B31 one size per part, U5 nothing in a corner's curve).

states.shows: the nav and the screen title

controls.on_tap: goes back to the screen it came from
